properties.dose: Smoked Light: 33mg Common: 66mg Strong: 100mg. Oral Light: 10-20mg Common: 20-60mg Strong: 60-100mg+
properties.effects: Sedation, Appetite enhancement, Muscle relaxation, Muscle spasms, Nausea, Pain relief, Vasodilation, Creativity Enhancement, Anxiety suppression, Anxiety, Dream suppression, Emotion enhancement, Mindfulness, Paranoia, Sleepiness.
properties.summary: A common and widely used psychoactive plant, which is beginning to gain legal status for medical and even recreational use in some parts of the world. Usually smoked or eaten, primary effects are relaxation and an affinity towards food - a state described as being 'stoned.'
